notes.title: Dimensional Dilemma is live!
notes.content: This is the first major release of Dimensional Dilemma, a first-person physics-based puzzle game inspired by the likes of Portal, Recursed, and Stephen's Sausage Roll. If you love puzzle games, this is a game for you! There are many challenges that will keep players on their feet and continually thinking outside the box. If you're new to puzzle games, fear not! Hints are readily available for any piece of the puzzle, and there are many different paths to choose from if one seems too daunting. Dive in and experiment with the environment to forge your path back to the ship!
